name: Atlanta depot, Georgia Power PLL-18
notes: PORTABILITY TEST 2, now on the PRIMARY tariff via R-6. Georgia Power PLL-18 folds the demand charge INTO declining energy blocks keyed to hours-use of demand (kWh / billing demand): 18.943 c/kWh for the first 3,000 kWh down to 1.101 c beyond 600 hours-use. The minimum bill ($256.00 + $13.63/kW of billing demand) is a FLOOR, not a demand charge on top -- a low-load-factor customer pays the floor. Billing demand ratchet: summer = greatest of current and 95% of prior summer peak (the 60%-of-winter leg is unmodelled; every committed run bills a summer month -- stated, not absorbed). 30-minute basis. The earlier flat-energy placeholder is GONE; this profile now expresses the structure R-5 said the object could not.

tariff.notes: Blocks, floor, and ratchet legs read verbatim from Georgia Power Schedule PLL-18 (eff. April 2025 billing month) via research answer R-6. R-6 open item: the 400/600-hour tail-block boundary text deserves one re-verification before anything prices a >400 hours-use customer; block VALUES are unambiguous. ECCR/DSM/fuel/franchise riders not modelled.
